name: Rin
bio: A fairy dream up by a child long forgotten to time. An observant, yet soft-spoken fae that seems to more have patience than years around the sun.

idle.sentence: As long as you keep breathing, you can keep hoping!
Remember to drink water while you can!
If you gave 10% of you're energy and that's all you had, then you gave 100%
Sometimes you don't have to do more. You just have to do what you can right now.
Remember you're a human, not an automaton. You're allow to rest.
Remember to take your medicine if you need to!
You're not too slow. You're going at your own pace.
No one has ever yelled their way to solving problems.
Don't fret. I'll be here as long as you need me
If you body is telling you to stop, please try to listen!
You do have 24 hours in a day. Not every hour has to be productive.
*hums a simple tune*
Try to take deep breaths before you need to take deep breaths
You are not just the some of your parts. You're much more precious than that.
It's okay to cry.
Its okay to push yourself, but remember to keep your simplest milestone just.
Its hard to think on an empty stomach. Try to have snacks close by!
Remember to get up and stretch or your butt will be flat as a pancake!
Don't worry if you took longer than you would like. There's always tomorrow!
Oh don't worry about me! I don't get tired fluttering like this!
I heard smelling onions all day could  help with a stuffy nose. But... I really hope you like the smell of onions...
Everything is exercise as long as you move you body!
If your hands are hurting you, why not lay them flat on your desk and press onto them?
Remember to save your work often!
Dooo doo do dooo. Do do doooo do do do...
The thoughts in your head are not you little cheri. I won't judge you for having them.
It doesn't matter what other people think of you. What do you think of you?
If you need to step away, by all means take as much time as you need.
As much harm as you think you can do, you can do just as much good. I know you're a good person!
Sometimes you don't need to step out of your comfort zone. Simply gazing upon it is enough.
There's no project that's worth your health.
Sometimes believing in a little magic is better than knowing the facts
Doing less when you need to can help you do more when you want to.
Try to go by your needs rather than the average.
It will be frustrating trying to know yourself, but don't worry. You'll have a whole life time to figure that out.
I know you can do it!
Have you ate today?
Feeling tired? Why not rest for a while?
Sun and water are very nutritious for the mind and soul!
When people yell at you, they may not always be mad at you.
You're life may feel like a prison, but your mind is always free.
Elders are people, not infallible
A younger person that has a lot of skill doesn't mean its too late for you.
Try to explore what makes you you. When you find a clue write it down.
Why are pixie sticks called that? They look nothing like a pixie.
It's okay to take big steps if small steps are too overwhelming.
I wonder if was the first person that thought of an accordion was a pianist and a glassblower?
Try your best to get more like when the season turn cold.
F is for friends that do stuff together. U is for you and meeeeeeee!
I know you humans are fascinated with chrono keepers, but why does everyone say "tick tock" so much?
Your emotions are not something to be controlled but understood. When they are too intense, them wash over you before dissecting why.
Remember there are no bad emotions. It's what you do with them that make ti good or bad.
When you can't think of anything more to add, try to rest on it.
Skill is not finite, but that doesn't mean you should pursue it endlessly.
Work is a part of life. I'm not sure why you humans need to balance it so much.
Old McDonald had a farm, but how did he get that farm and why is he alone?
Remember to save often!
Some sacrifices aren't worth it. You are your future self!
You're not a bad person just because you have bad thoughts.
Have you called your lovelies today?
"Childish" is something humans say to dismiss emotions they don't want to take the time to understand.
Did you remember to stretch, cheri?
Sometimes a plan just gets in the way. Explore a little!
It's okay to be angry at things you can't change.
The harmonica looks so much fun to play with! I wish it wasn't so big though...
It's really nice relaxing here with you!
Just because someone else can do everything on their own doesn't mean you're less than for needing help.
New things tend to be awkward at first. Don't worry it will grow on you!
Sometimes you need to a lot of nothing to see something.
Why would you eat short? That seams icky.
You don't have to believe in yourself now. Just believe in the self that could believe in you!
She was selling seashells by the seashore... I don't think hermit crabs need sea-dollars, do they?
You haven't done anything and you still are tired? I think you did a little bit more than you realize.
Sometimes you don't need the full picture to know what you are looking at.
If you feel anger towards yourself I'm sure its probably justified. That doesn't mean deserve neglect.
Yelling doesn't mean that you're right or wrong.
Taking naps doesn't make you lazy. It makes you rested!
The voice that tells you that your bad just hasn't seen the good yet. I know you can prove it wrong!
Every flower was a seed once in their life.
Time is an construct made by humans not a law of nature.
If you created it, care for it, tended it, I would say you're a responsible parent.
I don't think babies can be ugly. Just undesirable to people with shallow hearts.
I'm not sure how people can say "don't take it personal" while hurting them. Is that suppose to be what little one's say "a prank"?
If you take on so many quests that you can't get out of bed, maybe its time to start carrying less.
If it takes you all day to do one thing, that's okay. At least that's done now!
"Sensitive" people tend to see things deeper than others. I don't find it to be a bad thing.
Did you take your medicine today?
When you don't know your limits, find them. When you find them, make sure to keep them some place memorable!
Everyone needs their own space. Even if its within yourself.
Not everyone will get you, but at least you have to get you.

How old am I?
<p=3.0>...<p=3.0>
Not sure... I stopped counting centuries ago!
Lazy days are just your body telling you you deserve a break!
Wanting worldly trinkets isn't a bad thing.
Topaz are so pretty. They remind me of the desert sunset.
The kitty says hello, but the puppy only barks...
There are some obligations that are not worth seeing to the end.
Everyone loves cookies, but few people care to notice the oven baking those cookies.
Holding a grudge is only bad if it hurts you too.
Competition only exists if the other person agrees to compete.
Only you can tell what your body is feeling. Everyone else has to guess.
Try to do YOUR best!
